answer: Mesa-trail milestone bond: each identity locks 60 credits to walk a five-stop mesa trail, filing a quill-signed receipt at each cairn. Auditors replay the trail log; a late or copied receipt burns the bond, and one forged quill signature sends a ripple across the trail. 1,000 fakes must walk 1,000 trails and forge 5,000 receipts — 60,000 fees plus 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent walks once, files five receipts, pays once.
